label: Cold Exit procedural rig (actor_rig.js / Assets/anatomy/*.json)
_handednessNote: The procedural rig is authored directly in code's coordinate system. leftArm/rightArm here ARE code's leftArm/rightArm — no flip applied at the loader level (the procedural rig builds with leftArm at world -X already).
_note: Procedural rig bones are accessed via the rig structure directly (rig.leftArm.shoulder.pivot, etc.) — there is no string-keyed bone lookup. This file documents the logical-group definitions for consistency with FBX/GLB rigs.
